subject: Expansion coverage & commit check — NimbleHealth
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@nimblehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion coverage & commit check — NimbleHealth

Hi Alicia / team,

Quick check-in ahead of Friday's commit review: thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our conversation, NimbleHealth is evaluating expanding to 3 additional product teams (Clinical Insights, Provider Search, and Patient Messaging). We captured an initial ARR expansion ask of ~$180k incremental for the next 12 months.

Two asks from our side to make the Friday commit useful for finance/ops:
- Can you confirm which product teams are in-scope and approximate go-live quarters (Q3 vs Q4)?
- Any procurement timelines or PO windows we should be aware of?

I've attached a snapshot that our ops team will use for the commit spreadsheet (Q2_expansion_MOPs.xlsx). Monica — can you own the handoff to CS with the technical readiness checklist? Marissa / Sean — I'll ping you both on the commit doc once Alicia confirms timelines.

If it's easier, we can do a 20-min quick sync tomorrow to align.

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0117

Attachment: Q2_expansion_MOPs.xlsx (spreadsheet, 54 KB)

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@nimblehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion coverage & commit check — NimbleHealth

Hi Vanessa / team,

Thanks — confirmed: Clinical Insights (targeting Q3), Provider Search (Q4), Patient Messaging (Q3 but scoped smaller). Procurement is lining up a contract bundle review mid-June; PO likely by late June/early July. I'll loop in procurement shortly, but they asked us to provide the expected start dates and an SOW estimate.

I'll attach a short internal summary to this thread later today. For the quick sync, tomorrow 10:00–10:30 PT works for us.

Best,
Alicia
Director of Product Ops | NimbleHealth
Alicia.Ramos@nimblehealth.com

Attachment: Nimble_internal_summary.docx (doc, 22 KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion coverage & commit check — NimbleHealth

Folks,

Thanks for the heads up, Vanessa. I can take the CS handoff and own the technical readiness checklist. Action items I'm going to run this week:
- Prep a short readiness playbook for Clinical Insights and Patient Messaging (API keys, routing, data retention defaults).
- Validate latency SLA expectations against the Provider Search use case (they expect p95 < 120ms for 512 tokens).
- Confirm internal resource availability for an implementation kickoff in July.

I'll update the Q2_expansion_MOPs.xlsx and drop a link in HubSpot once done. If Procurement needs a tighter SOW, advise on the minimum scope they should budget for (I recommend starting with Clinical Insights + small Pilot for Provider Search).

Quick note for forecast: based on pipeline hygiene today I'm putting NimbleHealth at Commit (60% probability) for the $180k expansion, with a conservative 50% commit for Provider Search until the SOW is agreed. We should flag this for the Friday commit review so finance understands risk.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: (none)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion coverage & commit check — NimbleHealth

Alicia — thanks for the sync earlier and for confirming procurement timing. Per today's call we captured:
- Clinical Insights: Q3 start, $95k ARR (Commit)
- Patient Messaging: Q3 start, $30k ARR (Commit, pilot scope)
- Provider Search: Q4 start, $55k ARR (Commit, contingent on SOW)

I've updated the commit spreadsheet and attached the Nimble renewal pack for finance (Nimble_renewal_summary.pdf). Monica will send the readiness playbook and example SOW draft by Friday EOD so procurement has something to review.

Next steps (short):
- Monica: readiness playbook + draft SOW (due Fri EOD)
- Marissa: add staged ARR entries to the commit sheet (done)
- Vanessa/Sean: provide a final consolidated commit line for Friday's review (I will submit)

Appreciate the fast turnaround — we'll flag any changes if procurement shifts the timeline.

Best,
Vanessa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Nimble_renewal_summary.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)
